goal: Report the telephone number on file for member 40021
description: Looked up member 40021 via Member Inquiry, opened Member Record, then Contact Details, and read the Telephone field.

params.name: member_no
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

locator.why: Read telephone number textbox value for member 40021

steps.intent: Initial visit to observe the application
Enter operator id to sign on
Enter pass code to sign on
Navigate to member lookup to find member 40021

target.why: Navigate to member lookup to find member 40021

steps.intent: Reload member inquiry form since textbox wasn't present

target.why: Reload member inquiry form since textbox wasn't present

steps.intent: Enter member number to inquire (retry with explicit index after page reload)

target.why: Enter member number to inquire (retry with explicit index after page reload)

steps.intent: Reload member inquiry form to retry after record-in-use message

target.why: Reload member inquiry form to retry after record-in-use message

steps.intent: Submit member inquiry for 40021, third attempt

target.why: Submit member inquiry for 40021, third attempt

steps.intent: Navigate to contact details to find phone number

target.why: Navigate to contact details to find phone number

steps.intent: Read telephone number textbox value for member 40021

target.why: Read telephone number textbox value for member 40021

recoveries.detect: RECORD IN USE BY ANOTHER TERMINAL
recoveries.why: The record lock is held by another terminal with no control to press, so waiting longer before the retry sequence resumes gives the lock time to clear instead of repeatedly re-navigating into the same hold screen.
